ui:
Added dimensional light, lavender edging and softened furniture detailing to the second- and third-floor clickable maps using saved room geometry, without changing original zone paths. Add white house notification badge asset, foreground chime test, and Samsung notification-channel sound help. Connected sections and useful tools to avatar areas and room doors, removed the oversized launcher from the dock; the full legacy launcher remains available internally as fallback. Installed-app icon switched to fresh, uniquely named pastel rainbow garden assets rather than the old moon; Android manifest, browser favicon, Apple home icon, offline cache and notification icons use the same colorful design. Spirituality class progress is preserved on the phone across app reloads, unfinished lessons can resume, and cloud pull/assistant sync merges spirituality lesson completion instead of losing it. Parenting and psychology lessons now open with guided practice, spoken read-aloud, and undo. Notification settings include Samsung notification category sound guidance.  The first-floor stair artwork now reads as descending to the basement and ascending to the second floor, with no arrow overlays. The second and third floor drawings now use matching pastel room illustrations, and saved upstairs photos are available in their room galleries. App and notification icons now use refreshed rainbow asset URLs to replace the stale moon icon.Car and work have separate avatar areas; task fill grows gradually. House room tiles show linked completion fill and open room details. SSD delivery is shown 10:30 AM–2:30 PM Monday–Saturday through Dec 26; backpack checks are scheduled after the latest child pickup in the first free slot, and stale morning reminders are repaired. Cleared project actions stay cleared, sync conflicts pause automatic overwrites for review, the Money account-exit checklist now uses working tap controls, Spirituality shortcuts keep consistent full-page navigation, and Money distinguishes linked accounts from budget-mapped accounts and separates balance dates from connection sync dates, and blocks confirmed-closed checking from available-cash mapping, and preserves subscription payment and renewal details across sync, and shows an estimated Added a Christmas 2026 gift planner to People → Birthdays + Gifts with recipient-by-recipient buy-or-make ideas, budget, and progress. Scheduled Christmas gift planning, purchase/making sessions and wrapping, plus Tree’s December 28 birthday tasks, categorized under Relationships in the avatar. Fix UPS schedule-photo parsing for 24-hour times and times beside printed dates. Add Christmas gift actual-spending totals, shopping links, and stable person-ID storage while preserving older gift notes. Add optional Quick Capture phone/browser dictation with a review-before-save step; explicitly stated water amounts are logged as water, with safeguards against identical active quick-capture tasks and shopping entries. Add dependency-free GitHub Actions regression tests for schedule parsing, gift saving, Quick Capture and app-release integration. No house-map or avatar geometry changed. Quick Capture now previews whether each line will save as Water, Shopping, or a Task before confirmation, and restores original in-memory records when a local save fails. Gift updates also restore their previous state on failed saves and prevent ambiguous legacy gift notes from attaching to multiple people who share a name. Expanded GitHub regression coverage and checked script syntax. Weekly UPS schedule saves now preserve actual punch and SSD mileage fields, honor intentionally cleared scheduled start times, and fully restore prior records if saving fails. Workday Focus has a one-tap SSD route logger: paste/enter SSD route start and end times plus starting/ending odometer, preview elapsed hours and derived mileage, and save only SSD delivery details while leaving preload punch times unchanged. Paid SSD hours remain unconfirmed until explicitly entered, and validation rejects backwards times or odometers. Automated tests cover schedule rollback, route calculations and save rollback, plus new script loading/offline integrity. SSD route import now distinguishes a labeled SSD time range from preload in a multi-shift message, blocks ambiguous pairs and conflicting manual-versus-odometer mileage, and reloads the selected date's fields when changing dates to avoid misattributed mileage. A user-triggered Copy SSD details action formats a text report for their supervisor without sending or saving automatically. Daily Check-in now links directly to Quick Capture and SSD route logging where available. Additional tests cover time ambiguity, date safety, clipboard summaries, and navigation. No house-map or avatar changes. Workday protection now delays flexible home tasks until at least 45 minutes after confirmed SSD delivery ends, without moving fixed school pickup or confusing a preload punch-out with route completion. Chat check-in distinguishes preload end from SSD completion and provides instructions for confirmed, authorized ChatGPT-to-Supabase intake. ChatGPT life-entry import fetches the full batch before changes, atomically saves new records, rolls back failed saves, and shows last-scan import counts. Assistant cloud patches and unsynced phone edits now require conflict review rather than falsely marking local work as synced. Cloud uploads track exactly the content sent, and queued edits stay pending if made during upload. Remote patch path safety and automated tests were expanded. Existing house-map and avatar geometry remain unchanged. Christmas gift editor now supports up to 30 additional independently tracked gift items per person, including buy/make method, progress, shopping link, and supplies notes, while keeping the legacy primary gift and existing per-person spending/budget totals. Form validation and saved gift tests cover old records, separate progress, and invalid links. Matching rose and lavender styling uses the existing colorful app theme; no house map or avatar changes. Added Android PWA Share Target for ChatGPT text. Shared content is held in a small device-local Cache Storage queue until the user reviews it; no conversation text is transmitted without confirmation. Daily Check-in now opens Review shared ChatGPT text, including clipboard paste fallback. The review screen supports confirmed water amounts, food/drink entries, completed child chores and tasks/projects, verifies dates and values, signs in to the user's own Supabase account for RLS-protected writes, uses idempotent external IDs to avoid double-posting a shared message, and requests import of newly saved entries to the phone. Automated tests cover water detection, no unconfirmed writes, authentication, duplicate saves and error messaging. This does NOT install a global webhook for every ChatGPT conversation; conversation auto-capture remains unsupported by the available ChatGPT interface. Existing house/room artwork is unchanged. Share-to-Daily-Life review now keeps previously shared messages recoverable in an on-device queue after closing the review screen or interrupted startup. Daily Check-in includes Review waiting shares; the share dialog can discard individual pending items with confirmation. Short explicit statements may suggest water, food, children's chores or task fields, but unclear or lengthy text is never automatically treated as completed. A cloud write and on-phone import now report success separately, so successful cloud data is never labelled unsaved due to a later device import failure. Cache Storage uses canonical URL strings to reliably delete or retrieve reviewed shares. Added regression tests for the pending queue, duplicate protection, conservative suggestions, cloud save/import boundaries, and Daily Check-in access. Automatic access to the full ChatGPT conversation stream is still not supported, and real Android share-sheet behavior needs testing on a device. House map and avatar unchanged. Reviewed ChatGPT task sharing now offers a clear Daily Life category picker with conservative suggestions for Relationships, Work, Home, Money, Health, School, Car, Pets and app upkeep. Cloud imports preserve a specific existing category against generic notes, and matching recurring tasks never removes other dates or other children's chores. Automated tests cover these safeguards. Reused five already saved Elfster wishlist links from People profiles in Christmas gift cards and birthday planning, with safe one-tap opening, add/edit shortcut forms, and honest labels distinguishing saved wishlist links and email activity from live wishlist syncing. Profile URLs are validated for secure Elfster domains; gift link edits preserve old data if device saving fails. Suggested gift ideas remain optional and never mark a purchase. No house or avatar geometry changed. Room detail modals now prioritize existing clickable chores and visible Previous/Next room navigation before room illustrations and secondary tools; visual house geometry and saved floor plans remain unchanged. Fixed Saturday/Sunday generated child chore scheduling to respect custody weekends, with a per-day Kids here/Kids away override in People > Chores. N/A does not mean Done: absent-child and N/A chore records stay preserved as history but do not count toward today's room, avatar, family or child task totals. Adult room routines are created independently so child chores do not swallow kitchen cleanup. Chore-first room pages prioritize actionable checklists and next-room navigation, reduce duplicate inventory clutter, and restore a clear desaturated-to-full-color room progress reveal without altering approved imagery or floor geometry. Added prioritized cloud tasks for cat urine cleanup and litter-box investigation, drafty doors and window weatherization, and laundry odor/cost setting review, dated Nov 15-17. Volvo 2011 XC90 oil maintenance now shows a current-mileage countdown with a 7,500-mile/12-month interval and early planning task when within 1,000 miles or 30 days. Validated SSD start/end odometer pairs from phone route logs and new cloud work entries advance the vehicle mileage automatically; distance-only reports never become odometer readings. Manual odometer check-in is available in Vehicle, and the next oil due date/mileage refresh from future logged oil changes. No house/avatar geometry was changed.
2026-11-15 map repair: preserved approved kitchen and room footprints; corrected second-floor main stair destination and horizontal stair treads, replaced reversed stair image with a contained L-turn basement staircase and ascending main stair drawing; added direct avatar-house navigation; redirected Today's shortcut to the map; category taps no longer invent tasks. Release build and regression metadata synchronized. Visual closet now checks the signed-in private snapshot whenever opened, merges missing clothing by stable ID without replacing unrelated phone changes, and refreshes after assistant sync patches. Included confirmed wardrobe, towel and illustration sync fixes.
Clickable photo-grounded furnishing markers in living and dining rooms, without changing approved first-floor kitchen art or room geometry. Route kids' reading to People and bathroom personal-care to Health. Syntax checks cover house and avatar scripts.
Room details show first six pending actions then an expandable list of every remaining task; room inventory is collapsed so the checklist appears first. No tasks are silently truncated. The Clueless Closet now shows a single large garment on a hanging rail with side peeks, swipe/arrow browsing, scrollable category chips, a collapsible outfit mixer, and a sharper private wardrobe sprite for the 14 confirmed Demitri pieces. It continues protecting the phone's other saved data.
Upstairs room outlines stay unchanged while confirmed, previously invisible furniture appears as clearly marked illustrative objects; missing placements are never saved as surveyed positions. Exact saved object positions take precedence. Room details expose real saved photographs in a single tap beneath the illustrated view. Corrected generic staircase accessibility wording. Demitri and household visual closets now flip through one full-size hanging garment at a time with swipe, arrows and keyboard navigation rather than item boxes. The outfit mixer and saved looks fold away until needed. Demitri's 14 illustrated clothing images are now available as 270-pixel private WebP images instead of 64-pixel enlarged previews, with a revision-aware cloud sync that preserves garment status.
Third-floor landing now connects to the bedroom with a short schematic passage/doorway, NOT a false second stair flight. Second-floor main landing illustrates the confirmed window and plants while preserving traced stair geometry. Saved room photo viewer accepts JPEG, PNG and WebP MIME types.
Bedroom bedding colors and accents now derive from confirmed bed descriptions saved in the private house map: pale lavender, dinosaur-themed green, light blue, and yellow cover with white floral quilt and blue pillows where recorded. Unknown bedroom bedding stays neutral rather than guessing by child name.
First-floor playroom now shows the confirmed digital keyboard and yellow hanging mesh organizer on the approved illustrated map, using dotted unmeasured positions and working object taps; kitchen untouched. Third-floor entryway illustration now draws a photo-referenced window, sloped eave and dark under-eave storage rather than a generic hallway.
Mapped furniture's View saved reference photos shortcut now opens the dedicated real-photo gallery instead of the unrelated notes/inventory panel.
One-time phone-state repair for both cats' flea reminders: convert stale November 15 task into active December 1 task, create a monthly-first recurring rule, and mark migration v2 so later intentional pauses or changes aren't overwritten. Cloud snapshot already reconciled and verified.
Room-daily chores continue to exist in their clickable house rooms, but the avatar Home task list and next check-in no longer duplicate them. Home shows one concise Open rooms shortcut with a remaining step count; no task or completion data is deleted.
Fix a blank-category crash when every pending daily review was skipped. The review page now correctly displays the Show skipped state instead of dereferencing an absent active review.
Screen-based mobile cleanup: remove floating Search/Add rails over Avatar and House checklists, shrink huge buttons, keep content above bottom nav, replace mandatory room assignment cards with compact house-wide tasks, simplify item dialogs, clarify cloud-status wording, collapse money goals until requested.
data_version: Digital wardrobe item colors, types, and SSD outfit selection are stored in the existing settings snapshot. Existing photos, tasks, habits, inventory, and cloud records are unchanged. Wardrobe garment-analysis results sync in settings; the optional Google API key stays in encrypted Supabase Vault. Cartoon copies are stored as new photo-inbox rows; original uploads remain unchanged. Each wardrobe item can now store daypart, season, and SSD usage rules alongside its reviewed garment details. Manual wardrobe selections store a date and daypart override in existing settings.
